description: Use this only when the person asks to talk with, or play out the meeting with, the buyers who'll be in the room. Andru writes a brief of what each person likely thinks going in (10 briefs a day), then plays them, one or several at once, in a Deal Prep session of 25 turns, asking what real buyers ask. Say "End role-play. How did I do?" for a scored debrief and what to take into the meeting. For the written brief alone, use get_pre_brief; it writes the same brief this session starts from. Paid. Check the price with quote before running.

brief_id.description: The brief to open a session from.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional: any unique string for this call. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and never charges twice.

maxAmountCents.description: Optional: the most this call may cost, in cents. If the price is higher, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

meeting.description: The meeting in a sentence, when it isn't on the calendar.

message.description: mode=reply: what the seller says to the buyer. "End role-play. How did I do?" ends with a debrief.

mode.description: meetings = the user's calendar meetings in the next 7 days (free). brief = the free brief for a meeting (10 a day). opening = open a session ($5) from a brief_id, or with one buyer. reply = the founder's next message; speaker picks who answers. list = the user's six buyers (free).

persona.description: Which of the user's six buyers to simulate (mode=list shows them, from their buying committee). Pick based on who the user is preparing to meet.

productDescription.description: What the user's product does. Defaults to the product in their ICP.

productName.description: Product name. Defaults to the product in their ICP.

quoteId.description: Optional: the quote_id from quote, to pay the quoted price (held for 30 minutes).

room.description: Who's in the room, 1–8 people, each with persona (one of the six buyers) and an optional title and name.

session_id.description: The Deal Prep session to continue (returned by mode=opening). Required for mode=reply.

session_key.description: Optional idempotency key for opening a session: retrying with the same key never charges twice.

speaker.description: Who answers this turn (p1, p2…, from the brief).

name: simulate_buyer_persona
title: Prepare with buyer role-play
